content.title: Miners stumble as gold falls, Needham cuts Coinbase price target
content.description:
Yahoo Finance host Josh Lipton tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including mining stocks Newmont (NEM) and Freeport-McMoRan (FCX) falling as gold (GC=F) and silver prices (SI=F) slide from recent record highs, while Needham analysts cut their price targets on crypto-related companies Coinbase Global (COIN) and Robinhood Markets (HOOD).

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.title: Stocks to Watch Monday Recap: Lululemon, Newmont, DigitalBridge
content.summary: 🔎 Lululemon (LULU): The sports-clothes maker's founder, Chip Wilson, is launching a proxy fight to remake the company’s board while Lululemon searches for a new CEO. Shares advanced 1.7%, bucking the downward trend in stocks.

content.title: Metals Selloff Hits Mining Stocks
content.summary: Although futures prices for gold, silver and copper in the U.S. fell sharply Monday, they remain near records after a wild year of trading.  At the close Monday, gold-mining giant Newmont was down 5.6% and silver specialist Hecla Mining fell 5%.  Phoenix-based Freeport-McMoran and Southern Copper dropped 2.9% and 2.8% respectively.

content.title: Tesla, These Mining Giants Are S&P 500's Biggest Losers Monday
content.summary: Tesla as well as Newmont and two other mining giants were the S&P 500's biggest losers Monday. But all are still near 52-week highs.

content.title: These Stocks Moved the Most Today: Nvidia, Tesla, Newmont, DigitalBridge, Praxis Precision, Ultragenyx, and More
content.summary: Nvidia and Tesla shares fall, DigitalBridge jumps after SoftBank agrees to acquire the data-center investment firm, and Newmont slumps as precious metals prices tumble.

content.title: Freeport Stock Rises 35% in 3 Months: What's Driving the Rally?
content.summary: FCX stock jumps more than 35% in three months, fueled by surging copper prices and progress at the Grasberg mine in Indonesia.

content.title: Stocks Head Lower as Tech and Metal Rallies Reverse Course
content.summary: A reversal in the recent rallies in technology stocks and precious metals was the main culprit in Monday’s stock market slide. The S&P 500 was down 0.3% on a day when roughly half the stocks in the index were trading higher.
